name: Boiler forced-draft fan and inlet silencer
description: Fan that pushes combustion air through the windbox, burner and gas passes, and can also convey flue gas through catalysts, economiser, FGR ducting and stack. Arrangements 3, 4 and 7 are offered; inlet silencers and filters reduce intake noise and protect the fan, and a variable-speed drive can replace damper control at part load.

specifications.basis: Halgo Power lists AMCA arrangements 3, 4 and 7
A portion of flue gas is routed to the FD fan intake and mixed with fresh air; dampers regulate both streams to lower flame temperature and NOx
Sized to attach directly to the fan inlet and reduce intake noise to a specified decibel limit
VFD offered in lieu of dampers; many package boilers operate at a fraction of nameplate

gaps.what: fan duty, static pressure and power for named boiler sizes
gaps.why: The read product page is descriptive and carries no fan performance table.
